reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering Qi crops and currency, fishing tackle, fertilizer, retaining soil, sprinklers, minerals, luck items, and radioactive materials and fish were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary and cross-asset names, crop timing, gameplay effects, soil instructions, sprinkler coverage, regulatory wording, object gender, and quoted terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Pyrite_Description.translation: Cunoscută în mod obișnuit drept „Aurul proștilor”.

QiBean_Description.source: Plant these in any season. Water every day to produce a Qi Fruit. Takes 4 days to mature.
QiBean_Description.translation: Plantează-le în orice anotimp. Udă-le zilnic pentru a produce un Fruct Qi. Ajung la maturitate în 4 zile.

QiFruit_Description.source: Mr. Qi has challenged you to ship 500 of these strange melons.
QiFruit_Description.translation: Domnul Qi te-a provocat să expediezi 500 dintre acești pepeni ciudați.

QiGem_Description.source: A special currency honored by Mr. Qi.
QiGem_Description.translation: O monedă specială acceptată de Domnul Qi.

QiSeasoning_Description.source: Just a dash will elevate any dish to extraordinary heights. Automatically applied when cooking.
QiSeasoning_Description.translation: Doar un praf ridică orice preparat la un nivel extraordinar. Se aplică automat când gătești.

QualityBobber_Description.source: Boosts the quality of fish that you catch.
QualityBobber_Description.translation: Mărește calitatea peștilor pe care îi prinzi.

QualityFertilizer_Description.source: Improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
QualityFertilizer_Description.translation: Îmbunătățește calitatea solului, mărind șansa de a obține recolte de calitate. Amestecă-l în solul afânat.

QualityRetainingSoil_Description.source: This soil has a good chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
QualityRetainingSoil_Description.translation: Acest sol are șanse mari să rămână udat peste noapte. Amestecă-l în solul afânat.

QualitySprinkler_Description.source: Waters the 8 adjacent tiles every morning.
QualitySprinkler_Description.translation: Udă cele 8 dale adiacente în fiecare dimineață.

Quartz_Description.source: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
Quartz_Description.translation: Un cristal transparent întâlnit frecvent în peșteri și mine.

RadioactiveBar_Description.source: Known by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.
RadioactiveBar_Description.translation: Potrivit Comisiei pentru Siguranță din Orașul Zuzu, provoacă vătămări corporale ireversibile.

RadioactiveCarp_Description.source: A carp that spent one too many years in toxic sludge.
RadioactiveCarp_Description.translation: Un crap care a petrecut prea mulți ani în nămol toxic.
